title: The Lion and the Boar
summary: On a scorching summer day, a lion and a wild boar reached a small spring at the same moment, fighting fiercely over who should drink first....
full_text:
On a scorching summer day, a lion and a wild boar reached a small spring at the same moment, fighting fiercely over who should drink first.

Pausing to catch their breath, they looked up and saw a flock of vultures circling overhead, waiting to feast on whoever fell in battle.

The beasts immediately reconciled: "Better to share the spring as friends than become dinner for the vultures!"
moral: Better to reconcile with your adversary than perish and become food for vultures.
